proves.claim: A submit with submit.residentChecks on and a resident process running runs the commit hooks and leaves the same marks on the item as with it off.

cli.journeys-submit-resident-parity.a-su.why: Without it, a regression where the resident preflight changes what a submit runs or records would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: The gate job queued by a submit with submit.residentChecks on and a resident process running has the same files, checks and proof list as the one queued with it off.

cli.journeys-submit-resident-parity.the-.why: Without it, a regression where the resident preflight changes what the queued gate job asks a runner to prove would pass unnoticed.
